They are massive, bumbling humanoids with brutish limbs and wiry blonde hair. They may spawn with a large tree trunk in their hand. == Drops == {{drop table|{{drop row|item=Coins|0star=20-29|1star=40-58|2star=80-100}} {{drop row|item=Troll hide|0star=5|1star=10|2star=20}} {{drop row|item=Troll trophy|0star=50%|1star=50%| 2star=50%}}}} == Spawning == {{spawn table| {{spawn row|type=[[Spawn zones|Anywhere]] in [[Black Forest]] |limit=1|frequency=1|stars=After 2000 meters from the world center}} {{spawn row|type=Possible [[Spawn points|spawn point]] outside [[Troll Cave]]s in [[Black Forest]]|frequency=0}} {{spawn row|type=Possible [[Spawn points|spawn point]] inside [[Troll Cave]]s in [[Black Forest]]|frequency=0}} {{spawn row|type=During "The ground is shaking" [[Events|event]] after defeating [[The Elder]]|limit=2|frequency=6|stars=Yes, if a [[Love Potion]] is active. Otherwise, No.}} {{spawn row|type=[[Spawn zones]] in [[Black Forest#Alternative biomes|Troll Black Forest]]|limit=2|frequency=667|stars=Yes}} }} == Attacks and abilities == Trolls come in two variants: 1/3rd of Trolls are equipped with a log, while the others are unarmed. Unarmed Trolls have three attacks. === Punch === Leans back before swinging to attack the player in a 5-meter 45-degree horizontal arc (60 [[Damage types#Blunt|Blunt]], 100 Tier 2 [[Damage types#Chop|Chop]] and 40 Tier 2 [[Damage types#Pickaxe|Pickaxe]] damage). This attack can be used every 4 seconds when within 4 meters of a player. === Ground slam === Lifts both fists up before slamming them down into the ground (70 [[Damage types#Blunt|Blunt]], 100 Tier 2 [[Damage types#Chop|Chop]] and 40 Tier 2 [[Damage types#Pickaxe|Pickaxe]] damage). This slam reaches 4.5 meters out in a 90-degree vertical arc, and can be used every 20 seconds when within 5 meters of a player. This effectively means that the Troll will punch five times before doing a slam, assuming that the player is always in range. When the slam hits anything, including the ground, it also creates a 3-meter area that deals 50 [[Damage types#Blunt|Blunt]], 50 Tier 2 [[Damage types#Chop|Chop]] and 30 Tier 2 [[Damage types#Pickaxe|Pickaxe]] damage. This area damage is the same at every star level. === Throw === Throws a large boulder at players within 8–20 meters (50 [[Damage types#Blunt|Blunt]], 60 Tier 0 [[Damage types#Chop|Chop]] and 40 Tier 0 [[Damage types#Pickaxe|Pickaxe]] damage). The boulder travels at an initial velocity of 15 meters per second and can travel for 4 seconds before disappearing. It has a spread of 10–20 degrees. This has a cooldown of 10 seconds and can be disabled by standing close to the Troll. Log Trolls have two attacks. === Log swing (vertical) === Slams their log into the ground extending out 9 meters and spanning across 90 degrees (70 [[Damage types#Blunt|Blunt]], 100 Tier 2 [[Damage types#Chop|Chop]] and 40 Tier 2 [[Damage types#Pickaxe|Pickaxe]] damage). This attack can be used every 6 seconds when within 8 meters of a player. === Log swing (horizontal) === Swings their log from the side, creating a 10-meter 50-degree arc (60 [[Damage types#Blunt|Blunt]], 100 Tier 2 [[Damage types#Chop|Chop]] and 40 Tier 2 [[Damage types#Pickaxe|Pickaxe]] damage). This attack can be used every 6 seconds when within 8 meters of a player. ==Strategy== {{For|strategies for defeating Trolls|Aggressive creature strategies#Troll}} * Among the largest enemies in ''Valheim'', Trolls have a physical strength that reflects their size. Ranged attacks with a Bow or Spear are best and kiting a Troll through dense areas of the forest is very effective, as they have large hitboxes that hinder their pathfinding. * Trolls employ massive yet slow attacks that are easy to avoid but very hard to block and parry. Using a [[Bone Tower Shield]] is effective at blocking most of its attacks, provided the player has sufficient health. ** "Pulling" the attention of a Troll and brandishing a tower shield while other players fire arrow volleys is an effective strategy. * Trolls will sometimes fall into deep ditches or pits, or more often, the large pit at a copper dig site. Their poor pathfinding often renders them stuck. ** If a Troll approaches a ditch that is sufficiently deep (at least 6 meters) and does not fall in, it will not willingly walk in. Unable to reach the player, it will stand still, glowering into the pit. After a few moments, it will turn its aggression towards any player structures it can reach. ** Alternatively, if the positions are reversed, standing atop the ledge of a pit allows for easy dispatch with arrows and spears. * Trolls can spawn with or without a tree trunk in their hand. A Troll equipped with a tree trunk has decidedly better range and destructive power than one that is not. == Notes == * A 1-star Troll has a pale green tint, and a 2-star Troll is tinted a ruddy red. * They are tall (7 meters) and can move along corridors 2 meters and wider. * The curative pollen ejected by [[Greydwarf Shaman]]s also heals Trolls, as they share a [[Factions|Faction]]. * They cannot jump or swim, but they will walk along the bottom of shallow water, sometimes getting a considerable distance from the shore. They can walk through shallow water faster than a player can swim. * All the Troll's attacks (except its rock throw) have a [[Damage#Terrain_damage|tool tier]] of 2, which allows players to use Trolls to harvest resources they are otherwise unable to attain at their current equipment level. Trolls are capable of knocking down and breaking apart [[Oak]] and [[Birch]] trees with their attacks, which is especially useful in the early game for obtaining [[Finewood]] without a [[Bronze Axe]] (or better). Trolls can also break [[Copper Deposit|Copper]] and [[Tin Deposit]]s (even with their rock throw attacks), which can allow the player to get [[Bronze]] before killing the first boss, [[Eikthyr]]. ** Additionally, Trolls lured into more hostile biomes will aggressively attack most creatures in that biome, due to them having different Factions. While Trolls are not such a good match for stronger enemies, such as [[Plains]] creatures, they are capable of destroying large numbers of [[Swamp]] creatures, leaving loot like [[Entrails]] and [[Bloodbag]]s in their wake for the player to collect * The [[Love Potion]] increases Troll spawn rate, star chances and alerts them. == Gallery == Valheim Mountain-Troll-2 ver0-79-10.jpg|Mountain Troll preparing to smash a Viking in Deep Forest Troll in-game.png Screenshot 2021-05-18 9.27.56 AM.png|Recently updated Troll visuals Trollinswamp.jpg|Infuriated Troll lashing out at enemies in swamp (new model) File:1 star troll.png|A 1-star Troll at night. File:Helpless.jpg|A Troll trapped and helpless in a defensive ditch. == Trivia == * In Old Norse sources, Trolls were assimilated to Jötnar, the giants from Norse mythology. Only in later Scandinavian folklore did they appear as separate beings. * During the alpha, Trolls in the Black Forest had brown skin covered by green moss, while Trolls in the Mountains had blue skin.https://archive.md/s5GAU#selection-903.0-903.13 * The trophy of the brown Troll from the alpha build can be spawned with the command "spawn TrophyForestTroll", and the current troll trophy with "spawn TrophyFrostTroll" * The alpha build Troll trophy can be placed on an [[Item Stand]], however, it is invisible. == Lore == {{Quote|The trolls of Midgard may be fading from your memory, as indeed they are from all the race of man. Few and forlorn, they crouch in damp caves and gnaw on the bones of the weak and foolhardy. The will of Odin has pushed them back into the dark places. But in Valheim they have flourished. It has been centuries since any in Midgard saw the great Trolls stamp flat the land and bring down the trees for joy. Look upon this great and noble sight, wanderers in a strange land! Then take to your heels and run...|[[Runestone]]}} == References == {{Creatures}} [[ru:Тролль]] [[uk:Троль]] [[fr:Troll]] [[cs:Troll]] [[de:Troll]]

They are small flaming imps that are relatively weak, especially in [[Swamp]]s where the constant raining significantly reduces the damage from their ranged fireball attack. == Attacks and abilities == {{For|strategies for defeating Surtlings|Aggressive creature strategies#Surtling}} Surtlings spawning near [[Fire geysers]] can be farmed through lowering the ground around the spawn area with a pickaxe. As soon as the Surtling spawns in water, it will take damage and quickly die. === Fireball === Winds back before tossing a ball of fire at the player, which applies the [[Burning]] status (10 [[Damage types#Blunt|Blunt]] and 40 [[Damage types#Fire|Fire]] damage). This attack has a 3-second cooldown and can be used within 10 meters of a player. The fireball travels at 11 meters per second for up to 4 seconds before despawning and has a spread of 2–20 degrees. == Drops == {{drop table|{{drop row|item=Coal|0star=4|1star=8|2star=16}} {{drop row|item=Surtling core| 0star=50%|1star=2|2star=4}} {{drop row|item=Surtling trophy|0star=5%| 1star=5%|2star=5%}}}} == Spawning == {{spawn table| {{spawn row|type=3 [[spawn points]] near [[Fire geysers]]|frequency=Respawn after 5 minutes}} {{spawn row|type=During "There's a smell of sulfur in the air..." [[Events|event]] after defeating [[Bonemass]]|limit=4|frequency=6|stars=No}} }} == Notes == * Surtling is a reference to [[wikipedia:Surtr|Surtr]], also anglicized as 'Surt', a mighty giant fire jötunn in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Norse_mythology Norse mythology]. **Interestingly, in earlier versions of the game, among [[Runestone]]s the player may stumble upon in Swamp biome provided the origin of Surtlings as demonic creatures born from splintered fragments of Surtr himself after being struck down and mutilated by First Men. * The flames around 1-star Surtlings are blue, with 2-star Surtlings being pink. * Projectiles can be parried, staggering the Surtling for some time and allowing you to close the distance for melee attacks, and possibly pushing them into water. * While they take damage from water, rain does not affect them. * Before the [[Version history|Ashlands update]], Surtlings were very common and the only inhabitants of Ashlands. == Gallery == File:Valheim Surtling-1 ver0-79-10.jpg|

 == Lore == {{Quote|Let you who read me know of the Surtlings, that you might not fall prey to their wickedness. Long ago the great demon Surtr was brought down and destroyed by the First Men, giant warriors of whom you are but a dwindling echo. They smote long upon the body of this Surtr with swords and hammers so that his fiery substance was shattered into many small pieces. He who was made of the fire was fire in every part of him. You could not say ‘Here is the brain of Surtr’ or ‘Here is Surtr’s liver’ because every part was Surtr. So all the fragments of him were Surtr still, only much weaker in power and in thought and in memory, with no way to become whole once again. Now we call these fragments Surtlings and when they are found they should be stamped out like the last embers of a fire or doused with water to choke off their flames at the root. They will throw fire from afar and joy in causing terror and destruction. Even in his scattered dotage, the demon seeks revenge on the children of the First Men.|[[Runestone]]}} {{Creatures}} [[ru:Суртлинг]] [[uk:Вогневик]] [[fr:Surtling]] [[cs:Surtling]] [[de:Surtling]]

Offer it to the Sacrificial Stones. | trophy id = TrophyTheElder | id = gd_king | type = Boss | summon = [[Ancient Seed]] x3 | behavior = Aggressive | tameable = No | location = * [[Black Forest]] | drops = * [[The Elder Trophy]] * [[Swamp Key]] * [[The Elder Power]] | health 0star = 2500 | damage 0star = * Shoot: 35 Pierce, 20 Chop, 20 Pickaxe * Stomp: 60 Blunt, 1000 Chop, 1000 Pickaxe | abilities = * Root Spawn (25 seconds) * Shoot (6 seconds) * Stomp (5 seconds) | veryweak = Fire | weak = | resistant = | veryresistant = | immune = Poison, Spirit, Stagger | neutral = | aggressive = |faction=Boss}} '''The Elder''' is the second [[Creatures#Bosses|boss]]. He appears as a towering humanoid tree-like entity with multiple thin branches sprouting out of his slender, bark-covered body. == Summoning == [[File:TheElderAltar.png|left|thumb|200x200px|The Elder's Forsaken Altar.]] The Elder's [[Forsaken Altars|Forsaken Altar]] is located in [[Black Forest|Black Forests]]. His location can be revealed when visiting [[Burial Chambers]] and sometimes ruined structures around Black Forests, where a [[Runestone|Vegvisir]] will reveal his nearest summoning location on the map. He is summoned by placing three {{Item Link|Ancient Seed}}s in his Forsaken altar in Black Forests. Like all bosses, the Elder can be summoned as many times as desired, provided the required materials are met. == Attacks and abilities == {{For|strategies for defeating the Elder|Boss strategies#The Elder}} The Elder has an environment aura that removes darkness and raining. === Root Spawn === The Elder will raise an arm in the air to summon 15 hostile [[Root (creature)|Roots]] within a 15-meter radius circle around the player. Roots can attack players in melee range but are otherwise immobile and will despawn after 18–20 seconds or when The Elder is defeated. Although not typically possible in regular gameplay, a maximum of 30 Roots can be active at once. This ability has a 25-second cooldown and can be used while within 30 meters of a player. === Shoot === A ranged volley of 25 vines directed at a target player (35 [[Damage types#Pierce|Pierce]], 20 Tier 0 [[Damage types#Chop|Chop]] and 20 Tier 0 [[Damage types#Pickaxe|Pickaxe]] damage per hit). This attack has a 6-second cooldown and can be used when a player is 15–50 meters away. He attempts to track players while aiming. Each vine has an initial velocity of 30 meters per second and a spread of 10–20 degrees. They can travel for up to 6 seconds before disappearing. === Stomp === A close-range stomp over a large area (60 [[Damage types#Blunt|Blunt]], 1000 Tier 0 [[Damage types#Chop|Chop]] and 1000 Tier 0 [[Damage types#Pickaxe|Pickaxe]] damage). It hits in a circle 5 meters in radius from the impact point. This attack can be used when within 3 meters of a player and is accessible every 5 seconds. == Aftermath == Defeating the Elder allows the player to unlock and enter swamp crypts (which are the primary source of [[Scrap Iron]] in the game) with the [[Swamp Key]]. === Drops === {{drop table|{{drop row|item=The Elder trophy|0star=1}} {{drop row|item=Swamp key|0star=1 per player}} |stars=0}} === Forsaken power === Mounting The Elder’s trophy upon his respective stone will allow the player to claim his Forsaken Power. This ability will grant the player and nearby allies the following effects for 300 seconds: * Health regen: +30% * Chop damage: +60% * Pickaxe damage: +60% === Events === Defeating The Elder affects the following [[events]] for that world: * Disables: "The forest is moving..." * Enables: "A foul smell from the swamp..." (if [[Bonemass]] has not been defeated) * Enables: "The ground is shaking." (if a [[Troll]] has died in the world) === Creature spawning === Defeating The Elder unlocks several creatures to spawn at '''night''' in unusual biomes. They can only have 0 stars: * [[Greydwarf Brute]] in Meadows. * [[Greydwarf Shaman]] in Meadows. * [[Draugr]] while it is "Misty" in Meadows, Black Forest, Mountain, Plains. * [[Odin]] in Meadows, Black Forest, Plains. === Traders === Defeating The Elder unlocks the [[Thunder Stone]] and [[Ymir Flesh]] for sale from [[Haldor]]. It also unlocks the [[Woodland Herb Blend]] from [[The Bog Witch]] for 120 [[Coins]]. == Gallery == File:Elder and friends.jpg File:TheElderAltar.png == Notes == * The altar provides a few hints on what items are used to summon him. First, the altar reads "Burn their young" referring to [[Ancient Seed]]s. In addition, the top of the columns are topped by statues that look similar to Ancient Seeds in shape. * Because of The Elder's location in the [[Black Forest]], additional enemies such as [[Troll]]s or [[Greydwarf]]s may join the battle and increase the difficulty significantly, especially at night. * The Elder's high-damage ranged attack can be effective in quickly gathering resources such as [[Wood]], [[Corewood]], [[Stone]], and [[Copper Ore]], without the use of tools. * In the in-game trophies menu, there is another description of The Elder, "Even in death, it seems to grin with secret knowledge." * When The Elder's trophy is mounted on an item mount, he will sometimes say: "Little thing of blood and bone, I should have snapped you like a twig! Now I wither and die, let the great tree have me..." The many names of The Elder: * In the game files, The Elder is also known as "gd_king" as well as "theelder". Likely to be interpreted as "Greydwarf King". * Warnings inscribed in a few of the [[Runestone|runestones]] found in the [[Black Forest]] refer to The Elder as "the One Who Walks" once, and "the Old One" twice:
''Beneath the ground, the roots of the forest twine together on a great loom. Pluck one thread and the whole weave will move. Chop down one tree and all the wood will know. Make yourself known to the One Who Walks, and he will seek you out.''
''Beware the Old One. The ravens say that in ages past he was a shoot of great Yggdrasil itself and a force of wisdom in the days when men and trees were friends. Now he scorns the axe and sets himself against the works of the Gods themselves. Odin banished him here for his pride but his roots are deep.''
''Seven were the creatures banished to this world by mighty Odin in the first days of his kingship. Seven gods and monsters too proud to bear his yoke. I have heard the tread of the Old Ones in the forest and have crouched in the shadow of the Mountain Mother when she flies. Of the others I know little. I will add to this stone when I have seen more.''

They are dark blueish spectral entities, cloaked with a hood covering their blank face. They emit a quiet snarling hiss sound when they are aggravated. Since they naturally spawn at night, glow and fly, spotting them from a distance is easy; their telltale glow reveals them even to inattentive players as they approach. == Drops == {{drop table|{{drop row|item=Chain|0star=1}} {{drop row|item=Wraith trophy|0star=5%}}|stars=0}} == Spawning == {{spawn table| {{spawn row|type=[[Spawn zones|Anywhere]] in [[Swamp]]s during the nighttime, despawn at dawn|limit=2|frequency=3|stars=No}} {{spawn row|type=Rare [[Spawn points|spawn point]] near [[Abandoned Hut]]s in [[Swamp]]s, also during the daytime|frequency=0|stars=No}} {{spawn row|type=During "You feel a chill down your spine..." [[events|event]] after defeating [[Bonemass]]|limit=2|frequency=5|stars=No}} {{spawn row|type=[[Spawn zones]] in [[Swamp#Alternative biomes|Hut Swamp]] at night|limit=3|frequency=17|stars=No}} }} == Attacks and abilities == {{For|strategies for defeating Wraiths|Aggressive creature strategies#Wraith}} === Melee === Swipes at the player with their claw, creating a 60-degree vertical arc that extends 2.4 meters outward (60 [[Damage types#Slash|Slash]] damage). This attack can be used every 2 seconds within 1.8 meters of the player. == Notes == * Wraiths can be especially dangerous when entering Swamps early on, with Black Forest-tier gear. It is best to avoid entering the biome at night for this reason. * Wraiths are the only ''renewable'' source of [[Chain]]s, the other major source being [[Sunken Crypts]]. * Because of their [[Damage#Spirit|Spirit damage]] weakness (and considering their [[Damage#Physical|Physical damage]] resistance), [[Silver]] weapons are around 90% effective, making them a good choice. However, due to Wraith's immunity to [[Damage#Frost|Frost damage]], the [[Frostner]] is only about 50% effective, making it a bad choice. * Wraiths can fly directly on top of you if you get under them correctly, making them unable to hit you, while being vulnerable to two-handed [[Clubs]] like the [[Stagbreaker]]. == Gallery == Wraith1.jpg Wraith2.jpg Wraith.jpg|A lone gliding Wraith preparing for an attack. == Lore == {{Quote|Rest, wanderer, and consider the wraiths. We know that when a warrior dies, their soul cracks open and seeps into the earth around them, thereby to nourish new life and strengthen those who follow after. Yet if a warrior should die with no great deeds to their name, their soul will be too thin and airy. It will flow upwards instead, like smoke from a hearth. These wisps of souls sometimes catch in the branches of trees long enough to form Wraiths, wretched shadows with nothing but bitterness and jealousy to drive them. Blown about the land in despair, they remain only to prey on those who are still living. Should you see one, kill it and count it a mercy.|[[Runestone]]}} {{Creatures}} [[de:Zorngeist]] [[fr:Spectre]] [[ru:Призрак]] [[cs:Přízrak]]

They are large canines with long, bushy tails that can be bred and [[Taming|tamed]]. == Drops == {{drop table|{{drop row|item=Wolf fang|0star=40%| 1star=2 (80%)| 2star=4}} {{drop row|item=Wolf meat|0star=1|1star=2|2star=4}} {{drop row|item=Wolf pelt|0star=1|1star=2|2star=4}} {{drop row|item=Wolf trophy| 0star=10%|1star=10%| 2star=10%}}}} ==Spawning== {{spawn table| {{spawn row|type=[[Spawn zones|Middle]] of the [[Mountains]] during the daytime|limit=3|stars=No}} {{spawn row|type=[[Spawn zones|Middle]] of the [[Mountains]] during the nighttime, despawn at dawn|limit=6|stars=Yes|frequency=5}} {{spawn row|type=From breeding|limit=4, within 10 meters|frequency=-|stars=Inherited from the parent}} {{spawn row|type=During "You are being hunted" [[Events|event]] after defeating [[Bonemass]]|limit=6|frequency=6|stars=No}} {{spawn row|type=[[Spawn zones]] in [[Mountain#Alternative biomes|Wolf Mountain]]|limit=8|frequency=4|stars=Yes}} }} == Attacks and abilities == {{For|strategies for defeating wolves|Aggressive creature strategies#Wolf}} === Attack === This attack has three variations, each with its own 5-second cooldown: a left-swinging bite, a right-swinging bite, and a lunging bite (70 [[Damage types#Slash|Slash]] damage). In practice, this means that Wolves will typically attack three times in a quick succession before retreating for a moment. These attacks extend 2 meters out in a 60.1-degree horizontal arc and can be used within 2 meters of a player. ==Taming== ''For general taming information and strategies, see [[Taming|Taming.]]'' Wolves can make for powerful allies, both when following a player and when roaming around the built structures. Nighttime Wolves try to despawn during the day, so the taming of starred Wolves must be started during the night. Tamed Wolves will not retaliate against players when they or other Wolves are attacked/killed. A Wolf attacked by a player will be frightened, running around the nearby area for a few seconds before returning to their normal state. Once the taming has started, they will no longer try to flee and will also eat during the day. Taming a Wolf takes 30 minutes, if given enough food. == Breeding == Wolves can breed provided the Wolf is happy and well-fed with [[Boar Meat]] or other raw meat except wolf meat, seeker meat, and bear meat, and there is another Wolf within 3 meters, and no more than 4 Wolves within 10 meters. Once these requirements are met, the Wolf will accumulate love points with each other until the pregnancy starts. Pregnancy will last a minimum of 1 minute, after which the birth of the baby Wolf is random chance. Once born, the baby Wolf will take 50 minutes to mature into an adult. == Gallery == Wolf1.jpg Wolf2.jpg 1a.png|Comparison of 0, 1 and 2-star Wolves. ==Notes== *A wolf's size is affected by its star ranking. A 2-star Wolf is significantly larger than a 0-star Wolf. *Wolves can be transferred by boat by building a dock with a plank directly over the boat's deck. Wolves don't like to use staircases, so make it as flat as possible. Once the Wolf is over the boat, break the planks it is standing on to load the Wolf onto it. *Wolves will try to fight [[Serpent|Serpents]]. *Wolves will take collision damage if placed on top of the boat. Collision can occur from fish, rocks, and other unknown entities. The collision can occur at any time regardless of the boat's speed; and when it does, it will instantly kill the Wolf. This also occurs with Boars. *When roaming around an area where enemies drop meat, Wolves can not only sustain their numbers but multiply at an alarming rate. '''Ulf''', also known as '''Ulf, the Brave''', is a mentioned [[Creatures|character]] in ''[[Valheim (world)|Valheim]]''.

== Biography ==
According to multiple [[runestone|runestones]] located in ''Valheim'', Ulf was a settler who died, thus being sent to the purgatory lands. He has spent at least three summers in ''Valheim'' and has seemingly traveled the world from end to end, leaving behind him various runestones detailing his life among the various biomes.

== Runestone ==
=== Meadows ===
''Heed these words of Ulf, a poor settler in a strange land. You will find here good [[stone]] and [[wood]], all you need to build a house. You will need to craft a [[roof]] to keep out the rain. Then you will need walls to stop the roof from falling down. Finally, you must have a door or it will be much harder to go in and out.''

''These things Ulf has learned for himself. Now he writes them on this stone to help others. Pray to [[Odin]] for his soul.''

=== Black Forest ===
''Rest awhile and remember Ulf, who carved this stone with his own hand but could think of nothing to say.''

=== Swamp ===
''Heed the words of poor Ulf and do not build your house beside the murky waters. Bad dreams and a soggy [[bed]] are all you will find. I leave this stone as a warning and go now to make my dwelling on higher ground.''

=== Mountain ===
''This marks the spot where the [[Moder|great drake]] was first seen by me, Ulf, in the third summer of my life in Valheim. She stopped here to leave a pile of dung holding the bones of [[deer]], [[boar]] and the skull of a [[greydwarf]]. I will never come near this place again.''

=== Mountain ===
''In these [[Mountain|mountains]] I cannot throw a [[Spears|spear]] without hitting something that wants to kill me. But from the heights I have seen sunny [[plains]] where life will be easier. I go now to make my home there. These are the words of Ulf.''

=== Plains ===
''This place was too hot for Ulf, a man used to brushing snow from his beard. He carved this stone and moved on.''

=== Mistlands ===
''[[Munin|The raven]] showed me how to make [[Staff of Embers|a staff that set my beard on fire]]. I will meddle no more with such things.''

''Weary of mist and magic, Ulf carved this stone. Now I go to find a less troublesome place.''

=== Mistlands ===
''Heed the words of Ulf and do not take the hats of the [[Dvergr (race)|short ones]] from their heads. They have no sense of a jest and the only cure for insulting them is to kill them. Also, their hats do not fit common heads.''

=== Ashlands ===
''I have not been happy for more than a day in any place since I came here but this place is the worst of all. Most things are on fire and the fishing is not good. These are the words of Ulf.''

== Trivia ==
* Historically, runestones were raised by people in Scandinavia and other places visited by the Norsemen. They were often memorials to dead men, written testaments to important events or even used as territorial markers.
